learning_outcomes.text: Explain internationalization versus localization and why they are separated
Describe locale-aware formatting of text, numbers, dates and plurals
Explain how bidirectional and right-to-left scripts change layout
Describe localizing content, assets and formats beyond UI strings
Explain the engineering workflow for extracting, managing and testing translations

Audit the UI for hard-coded strings and left/right assumptions, plan locale-aware formatting and plurals, convert the layout to logical properties, and define a translation and testing workflow.
